description: This file provides helper functions for discovering and resolving gateway service endpoints, SSH targets, and URLs based on gateway discovery data models within the OpenClaw project.

methods.name: resolvedServiceHost
methods.description: Resolves and trims the service host string from a gateway model, returning nil if invalid.

methods.name: resolvedServiceHost(_ host: String?)
methods.description: Trims whitespace and returns the host string if non-empty; otherwise nil.

methods.name: serviceEndpoint
methods.description: Computes the service endpoint (host and port) from a gateway model.

methods.name: serviceEndpoint(serviceHost: String?, servicePort: Int?)
methods.description: Validates and constructs a tuple with host and port, returning nil if invalid.

methods.name: sshTarget
methods.description: Generates an SSH target string based on gateway info, including port if not default.

methods.name: directUrl
methods.description: Constructs a direct WebSocket URL to the gateway service.

methods.name: directGatewayUrl
methods.description: Builds a secure WebSocket URL, selecting scheme based on whether host is loopback.

methods.name: trimmed
methods.description: Helper to trim whitespace from a string.

methods.name: isLoopbackHost
methods.description: Determines if a host string is a loopback address.
